stages.name: keys
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_definitions' AS fact FROM py_definitions UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_decorations' AS fact FROM py_decorations UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_callees' AS fact FROM py_callees UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_keyword_arguments' AS fact FROM py_keyword_arguments UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_assignments' AS fact FROM py_assignments UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_typed_parameters' AS fact FROM py_typed_parameters UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_annotation_tokens' AS fact FROM py_annotation_tokens UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_base_tokens' AS fact FROM py_base_tokens UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,'py_assigned_tokens' AS fact FROM py_assigned_tokens

stages.name: per_fact
stages.query: SELECT fact,count(*) AS n,min(__path) AS path FROM keys GROUP BY fact

query: SELECT path,0 AS start_byte,0 AS end_byte,fact,n FROM per_fact
